title: BashBox: A Sandboxed Bash Interpreter for AI Agents in PHP
content:
BashBox runs AI-generated bash scripts in pure PHP, with a virtual filesystem, execution limits, and opt-in network access. No exec or proc_open calls.

The post BashBox: A Sandboxed Bash Interpreter for AI Agents in PHP appeared first on Laravel News.
